svg.text: ENTERPRISE RAG MULTI-STAGE RETRIEVAL & RERANKING CASCADE ARCHITECTURE
100 RRF -> 25 FlashRank/ColBERT -> 5 Cross-Encoder + Cutoff: 96.8% NDCG@5 in 42ms
500 Peak QPS / 10M Chunks: Tier 1 Vector Top-5 (71.2% NDCG) vs. Tier 2 Top-25 Stuffing ($185K/mo) vs. Tier 4 3-Stage Cascade ($19K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Low Recall, Bloat & GPU Stalls
1. Single-Stage Dense Vector Top-5 Only (Tier 1: 71.2% NDCG@5):
• Bi-encoder bottleneck loses exact SKUs, negations & fine clauses;
misses 28.8% of critical answers sitting at ranks #6–#80!
2. Top-25 Unreranked Prompt Stuffing (Tier 2: $185,000/mo TCO):
• Feeding 25 unreranked chunks (12,500 tokens) into the LLM wastes
5x prompt tokens & triggers "Lost-in-the-Middle" hallucinations
3. Heavy Cross-Encoder on All Top-100 Candidates (Tier 3: 485ms):
• Scoring 50,000 pairs/sec on full cross-encoders burns 16x A100 GPUs
Production Failure Impact (500 Peak QPS / 10M Chunks):
• Ranking Quality (NDCG@5): Only 71.2% (Tier 1) | 78.5% (Tier 2)
• Rerank Latency: 485ms P99 when scoring all 100 candidates (Tier 3)
• Monthly Compute + LLM Prompt TCO: $185,000 / month (Tier 2)
🏆 Tier 4: 3-Stage Funnel (`100 -> 25 -> 5`) + Score Cutoff
1. Stage 1 (`Top-100` in `8ms`): Hybrid BM25 + Dense Vector RRF:
• Captures 98.5% Recall@100 across semantic concepts & exact SKUs
2. Stage 2 (`100 -> 25` in `6ms`): ONNX FlashRank / ColBERT MaxSim:
• Ultra-fast late-interaction / 4M-param ONNX pruner drops 75%
of noise before touching the GPU Cross-Encoder (4x GPU savings!)
3. Stage 3 (`25 -> Top-2..5` in `28ms`): TEI Cross-Encoder + Score >= 0.35:
• Unpadded FP16 Cross-Encoder + dynamic score threshold cuts
generator LLM input tokens by 62.0% by dropping tail distractors!
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Ranking Precision (NDCG@5): 96.8% (+25.6 pts vs. Tier 1)
• End-to-End Retrieval + Rerank P99: 42.0 ms (11.5x faster than T3)
• Monthly Total TCO: $19,000 / mo (-89.7% vs Tier 2, -62% LLM tokens)
